note: Command files Artisan generates from module declarations (ModuleCommandFiles, kept equal by ModuleCommandFilesTest; regenerate with ARTISAN_WRITE_VECTORS=1). The editor reads each one and writes it back: the bytes must not change, or a Deploy would count the file as edited (moduleCommandFiles.test.ts).

files.yaml:
schema: command/v1
actions:
  - module_command: auctions:ah
aliases:
  - auctionhouse
  - hdv
permission: artisanauctions.use
description:
  en: "Open the auction house: now"
  fr: Ouvrir l'hôtel des ventes
subcommands:
  - name: sell
    actions:
      - module_command: auctions:sell
    permission: artisanauctions.sell
    arguments:
      - name: price
        type: integer
        required: false
      - values:
          - coins
          - gems
        name: currency
        type: enum
        required: false
  - name: admin
    permission: artisanauctions.admin
    subcommands:
      - name: reindex
        actions:
          - module_command: auctions:admin.reindex
        description: "Reindex #all"
        console: true
      - name: give
        actions:
          - module_command: auctions:admin.give
        arguments:
          - name: target
            type: player
            required: true
          - name: world
            type: world
            required: false
          - name: reason
            type: string
            required: false
